name: crypt_feaster_menace_two_blockers_may_block_it
notes: Printed: 'Menace (This creature can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.)' The probe shows one blocker refused. Here two opposing 1/1s both block the Feaster (3/4, no threshold: empty graveyard): the block stands, nothing reaches the opponent (20), the Feaster takes 2 and survives, and its 3 damage kills both blockers (one ordering pick is answered with the default).
